title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:

Hashrate holds firm at 923.8 EH/s, confirming miner conviction. Mempool stacks 106k transactions with fees at just 3 sat/vB, keeping the network cheap yet congested ahead of the next difficulty adjustment.
